description.en:
Opens a menu as a child scene: it queues a change to a "Menu" child scene (task Ie4MenuTask) with the menu name. The menu opens once the calling script suspends; wait for it to close with CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE.
Menus used by the scripts: "OrganizeMenu", "FormationMenu", "PlotMenu" (story chart), "SaveMenu", "ShopMenu", "KiznaxMenu", "TRouteMenu", "AddMember", "KMasterMenu" and "Staffroll".
Some menus take extra arguments:
- ShopMenu: an array of up to 3 integers, stored as Type, Act and No.
- KiznaxMenu: ID, Type, Handle (integers) and a BGM name.
- FormationMenu: a team number (TEAM_NO, default 0).
- TRouteMenu: a route ID and a BGM name (strings).
- AddMember: one integer (the scripts pass a character hash).
- SaveMenu: Prm_Fade, Prm_Caution and Prm_SaveMes (integers).
- KMasterMenu: one integer stored as NPC_ID.
The other menus ignore extra arguments.
Extra arguments of that menu (see the description).

true once queued.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
